audit_finding.flaw_identified: A naive universal shortcut 'max(train_year) <= 2021' conflated the outer training fold of the rolling cross-validation split (Fold 4 train years 2016-2021) with universal training rules. It falsely blocked the explicitly authorized final pre-holdout training on 2016-2022 (Stage 10 Full System Freeze), while conversely being too permissive for earlier folds (e.g. allowing 2019 or 2020 to leak into Fold 1 training).
audit_finding.solution_implemented: Refactored guards to validate dataset ROLE + allowed year range + operation type, enforcing exact boundaries per fold, authorizing 2016-2022 for final pre-holdout training, rejecting 2024 across training/calibration/selection, and rejecting future years (> 2024).

authority: docs/Aeolus_Probabilistic_Core_Arrival_Protocol.md - Section 21 (Stage 10 Full System Freeze before opening 2024)

year_roles_and_permissions.2016_2022: ROLLING_DEVELOPMENT (training allowed per fold rules or final pre-holdout)
year_roles_and_permissions.2024: FINAL_HOLDOUT (previously opened, evaluation only, training/calibration/selection/tuning strictly forbidden)
